issues.description: The problem statement's UML specifies a Stock.emptyStock() method, and the solution implements emptyStock(), but the template Stock class defines a method named clearInventory() instead. This name/signature mismatch is structural and can confuse students about which method to implement or expect to use (tests and problem text expect emptyStock).
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template with the specification and solution by renaming the template method clearInventory() to emptyStock(), or add an emptyStock() method that delegates to clearInventory() so the expected API (emptyStock()) is present in the template.
